# TECH BRIDGE '26 - ACETCM
> Official Technical Symposium platform for ACETCM'26 TECH BRIDGE Visual Rebus Competition by the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, Achariya College of Engineering Technology.

## Overview
TECH BRIDGE '26 is an interactive real-time technical quiz and visual rebus challenge.
- Round 1: Visual Technical Rebus (Foundations & Systems)
- Round 2: Architecture & Distributed Computing Visual Riddles
- Round 3: Live Buzzer Rapid-Fire Rebus Finale

## Organization
- Institution: Achariya College of Engineering Technology, Puducherry
- Department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
- Event: National Level Technical Symposium ACETCM'26
